guitar.notes: George Lynch is well known for custom Charvel and later ESP/Kamikaze superstrats with his 'skull and crossbones'/tiger graphics; medium confidence as no single guitar is as singularly iconic as e.g. EVH's Frankenstrat.

tone.target: bright 80s LA hard rock crunch with tight upper mids
tone.profile: bright 80s LA hard rock crunch with tight upper mids
tone.summary: A bright, crunchy signal chain built around the UK 45/UK 50 style preamp section, paired with a British amp model (UK SLP) and a classic 4x12 cabinet to achieve tight, upper-mid focused hard rock crunch.

rig.name: Dokken - Breaking The Chains - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum inherent in high-gain hard rock playing.
Provide initial bite and attack boost for the pick transients (pick attack bite).
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD/Overdrive to maintain clarity while adding necessary punch.

alternatives.reason: A more traditional overdrive option, but Boost is cleaner for pure bite.

blocks.purpose: Add aggressive mid-range crunch and sustain without the thickness of a full fuzz.
blocks.gap: RAT is chosen for its classic, biting hard rock tone, avoiding modern djent or thick fuzz sounds.

alternatives.reason: A more general option, but RAT provides the specific aggressive bite needed.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall JCM 800 style tone (UK SLP) for bright, upper-mid focused crunch.
Provide the necessary classic British cabinet sound (4x12) to ground the tone.
Add a slight 'sheen' and width to the tone without muddying the crunch.
blocks.gap: The chorus is optional, but used here to fulfill the 'slight sheen' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the upper mids and high frequencies to achieve 'bright upper-mid crunch' and bite.
Add subtle space and depth without losing the aggressive hard rock punch.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly to add 'sheen' while keeping the tone tight.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and upper-mid focus to nail the classic 80s LA hard rock bite.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Vintage British 4x12 IR (e.g., Celestion Greenback or similar)
proposals.reason: Enhance the specific upper-mid bite and vintage character missing from the default cab.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and punch in the mids/highs.
